main.summary: Generates per-tool manifest companions and assembly bootstrap helpers from analyzed KusDepot tool types.

method.name: Initialize
method.summary: Initializes the incremental pipeline that discovers attributed tool types and schedules manifest source emission.

method.name: Execute
method.summary: Analyzes the discovered tool types, reports shared diagnostics, and emits source for the valid manifest models.
method.param: The candidate tool types discovered by the syntax pipeline.
The source production context used to report diagnostics and add generated source.

method.name: GenerateAssemblySource
method.summary: Builds the generated assembly bootstrap source that can register and bind every discovered tool manifest companion.
method.param: The generated tool models to include in the assembly bootstrap.
The resolved assembly-level generation metadata controlling namespace, type-name, and module-initializer behavior.
method.returns: The generated assembly bootstrap source text.

method.name: GenerateToolSource
method.summary: Builds the generated manifest companion source for a single analyzed tool model.

method.name: EscapeStringLiteral
method.summary: Escapes a managed string value for emission into generated C# source literals.
method.param: The string literal value to escape.

method.name: SanitizeIdentifier
method.summary: Normalizes arbitrary text into a safe C# identifier for generated type names.
